units.source_text: 拉卟一本正经的说着，但他的偏偏大腹却不停起伏，似乎这件事很搞笑一样。

en.t: Rapu spoke with a perfectly serious face, but his great belly kept rising and falling, as if he found the whole thing hilarious.

units.source_text: 但却没时间笑，忙着要去抓一只河童——一只趁我不在意偷走我钢笔的河童。

en.t: But there was no time to laugh; I was busy trying to catch a kappa, one that had stolen my fountain pen when I was not paying attention.

units.source_text: 可是，河童的皮肤十分光滑，很难抓住。

en.t: But a kappa's skin is extremely smooth, making it very hard to catch.

units.source_text: 那只河童撒腿就跑，他像蚊子般的瘦躯几乎趴在地下了。

en.t: That kappa took to its heels and ran, its mosquito-thin body almost flattened against the ground.
